form.label: Technical Coverage
form.description: Shared 24-hour monitoring evidence for active frameworks. These signals support an assessment and never replace scope, ownership, or assessor judgment.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_catalog.csv | lookup ccp_framework_selections framework_key OUTPUT selected | eval selected=if(coalesce(selected,default_selected)=1,1,0) | search selected=1 | stats values(framework_name) as names count as framework_rows | eval active_frameworks=if(framework_rows=0,"No active frameworks",mvjoin(names,", ")) | table active_frameworks

div.p: Use current telemetry to see whether monitoring signals are available in the last 24 hours. A Pass means the signal exists, not that the underlying control is fully effective.
div.div: Recommended path: start here to find missing telemetry, open the related check, then save the result as evidence before making an assessment decision.

single.option: framework selection is managed in Framework Setup

search.query: | tstats summariesonly=false count where index=* earliest=-24h latest=now by index | stats count as indexes sum(count) as events | eval summary=if(indexes>0,indexes." indexes received ".events." events","No indexed activity found") | table summary events

| makeresults | eval Source="Splunk host metadata", measured=0, Assets=0 | append [| metadata type=hosts index=* | eval Source="Splunk host metadata", measured=if(totalCount>0,1,0), Assets=if(totalCount>0,totalCount,0)] | append [search index=ea_discovery earliest=-24h latest=now | stats count as Assets | eval Source="Exposure Analytics", measured=if(Assets>0,1,0)] | stats max(measured) as "Data available (1=yes)" max(Assets) as Assets by Source | table Source "Data available (1=yes)" Assets

| tstats summariesonly=false count where index=* earliest=-24h latest=now by sourcetype | eval Signal=case(match(lower(sourcetype),"auth|login|authentication"),"Authentication",match(lower(sourcetype),"audit|admin|sudo|privilege"),"Privileged activity") | search Signal=* | stats sum(count) as Events count as Sources by Signal | eval Status=if(Events>0,"Signal available","Not assessed") | table Signal Status Events Sources

| tstats summariesonly=false count where index=* earliest=-24h latest=now by sourcetype | eval Signal=case(match(lower(sourcetype),"alert|notable|detection|risk"),"Detection",match(lower(sourcetype),"vuln|nessus|qualys|tenable"),"Vulnerability") | search Signal=* | stats sum(count) as Events count as Sources by Signal | eval Status=if(Events>0,"Signal available","Not assessed") | table Signal Status Events Sources

| rest /services/data/indexes splunk_server=local | search disabled=0 NOT title="_*" | eval retention_days=round(frozenTimePeriodInSecs/86400,1) | stats count as Indexes count(eval(retention_days>=180)) as Meeting_180_Day_Target min(retention_days) as Minimum_Configured_Days | eval Status=case(Indexes=0,"Not assessed",Meeting_180_Day_Target=Indexes,"Pass",1=1,"Partial") | table Status Indexes Meeting_180_Day_Target Minimum_Configured_Days

html.div: How to use this: Open the relevant check, confirm the system scope and time window, investigate missing signals, then save the result with evidence and limitations. Technical availability is supporting evidence; it is not an automatic audit conclusion.
